scenes.text: Have you ever caught an error before it reached a patient? Then you probably have a story worth telling.
Me? I was just doing my job.
Most people underestimate their own work. Evinca's check takes two minutes. No account needed.
Where do you practise? Pick a category, like patient safety and quality.
Can you describe the problem, what you did, and what changed? Do you have a before and after, without patient data? Could someone independent confirm it?
Your evidence looks ready to shape. Nothing is submitted, and nothing is scored.
Three yeses. Maybe it was more than my job.
Check your eligibility in two minutes, free. At Evinca dot Healthcare Crown Academy dot co dot uk.
